# Sector Staff/Space Law Enforcement(SLE) Guidelines
\n
# Sector Staff - You must follow your departmental SOP to the best of your ability.
- Sector Staff are expected to maintain a minimum level of competency.
- Members of, or direct contractors/employees, Colonial Command are held to a higher standard.
- These roles are strictly non-antagonists. Engaging in Antagonist activity in these roles is prohibited.
- Abuse of the equipment provided to these roles is prohibited.
- Embezzlement of sector funds is prohibited.
\n
# SLE
- SLE and Outpost Staff roles are considered direct employees of Colonial Command
- SLE Officers roleplaying as 'bad' or corrupt cops and intentionally violating space law is forbidden.
- Space Law is not optional for these roles and must be understood properly before taking the position.
- Funds received from the sale of criminal assets are to be returned to their original owners.
- The SLE are allowed to use their knowledge of ship layouts to aid in ship searches.
- when encountering a smugglers pod, you may seize the contents of the pod and redeem it for SCU at the SLE Outpost.
- You [bold]may not[/bold] activate dead drops themselves nor work with others to activate dead-drops.
- Money found on board vessels belonging to hostile corporations, governments, or rogue-groups may be collected and deposited into the SLE bank account. Officers may not keep these funds for personal use.
- throughout the shift the commissioner is allowed to dispense bonuses from the SLE account, evenly and fairly, as they see fit.
